content: As a part of the coarse memory layer, knowledge aided mutual attention is aimed at fusing the question context embeddings INLINEFORM0 into the passage context embeddings INLINEFORM1 , where the key problem is to calculate the similarity between each passage context embedding INLINEFORM2 (i.e. the INLINEFORM3 -th column in INLINEFORM4 ) and each question context embedding INLINEFORM5 (i.e. the INLINEFORM6 -th column in INLINEFORM7 ). To solve this problem, BIBREF3 proposed a similarity function: INLINEFORM8
